title: A short PVM program, one instruction at a time
summary: Two `load_imm` instructions put equal values in two registers, and `branch_eq` compares them; the branch is taken, and the program ends at a trap. Gas is charged once per basic block, at the block's first instruction.
params: no chain parameters: the PVM alone
notes: The vector reports the exit at the instruction that caused it; $\Psi$ itself returns $\imath = 0$ on ☇.
name: pvm-inst_branch_eq_ok
check: Running $\Psi$ on the whole program gives the same status, gas and registers as the steps above, and they equal the vector's expected result (the comparison `lake build pvmtest` makes on every program vector).
